title: PfTALE5 Acts as a hub for multi-stress resilience: a genome-wide study of the TALE family in Paulownia fortunei.
authors: Tang, Xuefei; Zhao, Xing; Zhou, Mengyao; Fan, Guoqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文对白花泡桐TALE转录因子家族进行全基因组鉴定与胁迫响应分析，并用酵母双杂交和分子对接验证PfTALE5与PfKNAT7的蛋白互作，虽涉及TF-DNA家族但缺乏结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法以实验为主、分子对接仅作辅助，故为中档匹配。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Three-Amino-Acid-Loop-Extension (TALE) transcription factors are key regulators of plant development and stress responses. However, a systematic study of the TALE gene family in Paulownia fortunei has not been reported to date. RESULTS: Here, we conducted the first genome-wide analysis and identified 38 PfTALE genes, which were phylogenetically classified into the KNOXI, KNOXII, and BELL subfamilies. These genes were unevenly distributed across 15 chromosomes. Promoter analysis revealed abundant cis-elements associated with light, hormones, and stress. Transcriptome profiling and qRT-PCR analyses showed that PfTALEs were differentially induced by drought, salt, and phytoplasma infection. Among them, PfTALE5, PfTALE12, PfTALE16, and PfTALE18 were significantly responsive to all three stresses, suggesting pivotal roles in stress adaptation. Notably, PfTALE5 exhibited consistent and strong upregulation under all stress conditions and was localized to both the nucleus and cytomembrane. Furthermore, yeast two-hybrid assays and molecular docking confirmed that PfTALE5 physically interacts with PfKNAT7 via hydrogen bonds, implying their cooperative function in stress response regulation. CONCLUSIONS: Our study provides the first comprehensive genomic and functional insights into the TALE gene family in P. fortunei, highlighting PfTALE5 as a key regulator conferring multi-stress resilience. These findings offer valuable genetic targets and strategic guidance for breeding stress-resistant woody cultivars.
abstract_zh: 背景：三氨基酸环延伸（TALE）转录因子是植物发育和胁迫响应的关键调控因子。然而，截至目前，关于白花泡桐（Paulownia fortunei）中TALE基因家族的系统性研究尚未见报道。结果：本研究首次进行了全基因组分析，鉴定出38个PfTALE基因，并将其系统发育划分为KNOXI、KNOXII和BELL三个亚家族。这些基因不均匀地分布在15条染色体上。启动子分析揭示了丰富的与光、激素和胁迫相关的顺式作用元件。转录组分析和qRT-PCR分析表明，PfTALEs在干旱、盐和植原体感染条件下被差异性诱导表达。其中，PfTALE5、PfTALE12、PfTALE16和PfTALE18对所有三种胁迫均有显著响应，提示其在胁迫适应中发挥关键作用。值得注意的是，PfTALE5在所有胁迫条件下均表现出持续且强烈的上调表达，并定位于细胞核和细胞膜。此外，酵母双杂交实验和分子对接证实，PfTALE5通过氢键与PfKNAT7发生物理相互作用，暗示它们在胁迫响应调控中的协同功能。结论：本研究首次对白花泡桐中TALE基因家族提供了全面的基因组和功能见解，突出PfTALE5作为赋予多重胁迫韧性的关键调控因子。这些发现为培育抗逆木本品种提供了有价值的遗传靶点和策略指导。
